comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and mechanically locks an impact damper; record tensions and vertically plucks a chalk line to leave a straight mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate emphasizes tool alignment, setscrew loosening/relocking, fine collar adjustment, and repeated physical-cycle diagnosis. Record emphasizes maintaining 5–10 N line tension while the other arm lifts and releases a line with limited sideways error.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two repeatable non-bottoming stops under a ≥0.85 J impact and a post-lock retention test. Record grades the printed line’s mark alignment, bow, multiplicity, reel return, and release clearance. Missing candidate rubric details: numeric drift, rebound, overload, and tightening-torque thresholds; record also abstracts the line without cable collision/tension physics.
comparison.reason: Impact-response tuning with a mechanically retained setting tests a different ability from coordinated tensioning and impulsive line release, despite both involving bimanual force control.
